THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,

THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2017:KHC:32872  MFA No. 6945 of 2016  JUDGMENT
In this appeal, the respondent/owner has challenged the judgment dated 25.02.2015 passed in M.V.C.No.1805/2012 by the Fast Track Court and Additional M.A.C.T., Hassan ('the Tribunal' for short).
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties shall be referred to as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. Brief facts of the case are, on 27.11.2011 at about 07:30 pm, while the petitioner was walking by the side of the road in front of Sri. Keshava Murthy's house on Rachenahalli Main Road at sravanabelagola limits, hit by a motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA- 02/EL-1467 from behind injuring him grievously.

After taking treatment at S.C. Hospital, Shravanabelagola and Hemavathi Hospital,
Hassan, he has moved the Tribunal seeking compensation of Rs.5,00,000/-.
Claim was opposed by the respondent on the ground that he is not the owner of NC: 2017:KHC:32872 the motor cycle and he cannot be directed to pay the compensation.
After taking the evidence, the Tribunal has assessed the compensation of Rs.1,18,450/- directing the respondent to pay the compensation.
Aggrieved by the same, the respondent has filed this appeal on various grounds.

The respondent has also filed I.A.No.1/2019 under Order XLI Rule 27 of CPC seeking permission to produce B Register extract of motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA-02/EL-1467 to explain he is not the RC owner.
4. Heard the arguments of Sri. Girish. B. Baladare, learned counsel for the appellant.

5. It is the contention of the learned counsel that the respondent has taken a specific plea before the Tribunal that he is not the owner of the motor cycle in question and he is not liable to indemnify the petitioner for the injuries sustained.
In spite of it, NC: 2017:KHC:32872 the Tribunal has not recorded any reasoning that the respondent is the owner of the motor cycle but fastened the liability against him.

The respondent has secured the B-Register extract which shows the owner and address of motor cycle as 'M/s S.L.V. Distributing Company, No.18, New Timber Yard Layout, Behind Post Office, Mysore Road, Bangalore'.
This document is issued by the RTO, Bangalore West.
Before the Tribunal, the petitioner has neither arrayed the owner of the motor cycle nor the insurer as parties.
6. I have given my anxious consideration to the arguments addressed by the learned Counsel for the appellant and perused the impugned judgment.
7. Nowhere in the judgment there is a discussion or reference that the respondent was either the rider or owner of the motor cycle.

When the Tribunal holds a person to pay compensation, it NC:
2017:KHC:32872 is its duty to ascertain who is the owner and to what extent he is held liable to pay the compensation.

The petitioner has shown respondent as the owner of the motor cycle, but the Nanjundegowda vs N N Anand on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123046567/
2 material on record shows contrary.
Hence, the impugned order of the Tribunal lacks support of the Tribunal the evidence.

Hence, the petitioner has to be given an opportunity to implead the rider,
owner and insurer of the motor cycle and seek compensation, for which the matter requires remand.
8. The respondent has made out sufficient grounds to allow I.A.No.1/2019 for submitting additional evidence.
I.A.No.1/2019 merits consideration and also the appeal.

In the result, the following:
ORDER i) I.A.No.1/2019 filed by the respondent under Order XLI Rule 27 of C.P.C. is NC:
2017:KHC:32872 allowed, the respondent is permitted to produce additional evidence.
ii) The appeal is allowed.
iii) Impugned judgment and award is set aside.
iv) The matter is remanded back to the Tribunal for fresh disposal in accordance with law.
v) The petitioner shall implead the driver/owner/insurer of the motor cycle, the Tribunal by giving an opportunity to them to file their say decide the claim afresh in accordance with law.
As expeditiously as possible.
vi) Without further notice, parties shall appear before the Tribunal on 04.11.2023.
